pk/math.text: The child develops a sense of numbers and demonstrates early knowledge of counting
The child recognizes and names basic shapes
The child demonstrates an understanding of measurement
The child sorts, compares, and creates patterns with objects

pk/language.text: The child attends and responds to others in joint attention
The child listens and/or attends demonstrating understanding of language
The child develops the capacity to communicate using speech (in English and/or their native language), nonverbal gestures, and/or sign language
The child understands and uses an expanding vocabulary
The child engages in conversation in their native language, English, and/or sign language
The child uses conventions of language in one or more languages (grammar)
The child demonstrates an understanding of print awareness
The child develops phonological awareness (an understanding that words are made up of sounds)
The child participates in rhyming and word play
The child can identify letters in English and other alphabetic languages
The child learns letter-sound correspondence in English and other alphabetic languages
The child demonstrates an interest in literacy activities (e.g., community and cultural knowledge experiences, storytelling, read-alouds, chanting, singing, engaging with books, and writing)
The child demonstrates emergent reading behaviors
The child understands writing as a form of communication and recording information
The child develops awareness and representation of their own identity through name recognition and writing

pk/science.text: The child investigates the physical and natural worlds
The child recognizes their actions impact the environment
The child uses senses and tools to investigate objects and identify solutions
The child develops an understanding of cause and effect
The child designs builds, and tests solutions to solve problems

pk/social.text: The child exhibits imagination and creativity
The child engages in the dramatic arts
The child engages in the musical arts
The child engages in the visual and tactile arts
The child shows curiosity and initiative in interactions and experiences
The child displays persistence and pursues challenges through problem-solving
The child builds their capacity to retain and use information immediately (working memory)
The child enhances their ability to regulate impulses and responses (inhibitory control)
The child enhances their ability to adapt attention, actions, and behaviors (cognitive flexibility)
The child demonstrates self-awareness
The child demonstrates emotional development and expression
The child develops emotional regulation
The child demonstrates personal responsibility
The child develops an understanding of their identity and belonging in relation to their family, culture, and community
The child develops a sense of social awareness and inclusion of others in their learning community
The child demonstrates knowledge of their community
The child develops a sense of rights and responsibilities within a democratic society (civics)
The child engages and interacts with adults
The child develops relationships of mutual trust and respect with adults
The child engages and interacts with other children
The child develops relationships of mutual trust and respect with other children
The child works cooperatively with other children
